name: Foolish
overview: Scripture reveals that foolishness is fundamentally linked to a rejection or ignorance of God, as seen when the fool denies God's existence and engages in corrupt actions (Psalms 14:1). Trusting in one's own heart without divine guidance is folly, whereas walking wisely leads to deliverance (Proverbs 28:26). The apostle Paul explains that a foolish heart is darkened when people fail to glorify God and become vain in their thinking (Romans 1:21). True wisdom and salvation come through confessing Jesus Christ and renewing the mind to discern God's perfect will (Romans 10:9; Romans 12:2), while believers are called to avoid divisive teachings that contradict sound doctrine (Romans 16:17).
